name: Dah Sing Financial Holdings Limited
summary: Dah Sing Financial Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides banking, insurance, financial, and other related services in Hong Kong, Macau, Mainland China, and internationally. The company operates through Personal Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury and Global Markets, Mainland China and Macau Banking, and Insurance and Investment Operations segments. The Personal Banking segment accepts various deposits from individual customers; and provides residential mortgage loans, personal loans, overdrafts, vehicle financing, and credit card services, as well as insurance sales and investment services.
